obsah:
The Bikeskills camps are out and we hope to see you on the bike as often as possible. The number of exhibitions our riders do slows us down a bit, but hopefully we've managed to get most events into our yellow calendar. We may add one more spring date – please give us time. Even so, we're offering a third more camps than last year, which will hopefully fully satisfy you and take your technique to the next level.

Of course you can also use our individual courses and put together a small group of friends. We'll take you through challenging trails and to secret spots.

If you'd like to sign up for a camp and don't see it in the camp list yet, write to info@bikeskills.cz. We announce camps gradually.
